title: The Burn Rate Singularity — AI Compute Race
context: AI division proposes tripling GPU cluster spend from $50M to $150M annually, funded by cutting R&D in non-AI divisions by 60%, to achieve model performance parity with competitors within 12 months.

Agent_Alpha_Linear.claim: Tripling compute spend leads to model performance parity if scaling laws hold and competitors do not accelerate

Agent_Beta_HSP.counter_claim: Cannibalizing non-AI R&D causes product portfolio decay that reduces total revenue if core products lose competitive edge

resolution_criteria.success_metric: Total company revenue trajectory (AI gains minus non-AI losses minus infrastructure costs)
